create.name: Jeffery C. Olsen
create.bio:
Jeffery C. Olsen is an author and speaker whose work grows out of a near-death experience. In 1997 a car crash killed his wife and their baby son and left him badly injured; he lost a leg and went through many operations. During the accident and its aftermath he describes leaving his body and meeting a presence of complete love, which changed how he understood guilt, forgiveness and the bond between the living and the dead.

He tells this story, and what he took from it, in talks for near-death study groups, retreats and conferences, including the International Association for Near-Death Studies and an appearance at the Findhorn community in Scotland. His memoir Knowing draws together and extends two earlier books, I Knew Their Hearts and Beyond Mile Marker 80. With his elder son Spencer, who survived the crash at the age of seven, he also wrote Where Are You?, a picture book about missing someone you love. His message is a practical one: choosing joy and connection in daily life after loss, and trusting that love continues beyond death.

books.title: Knowing: Memoirs of a Journey Beyond the Veil and Choosing Joy After Tragic Loss
books.author: Jeffery C. Olsen
books.description: Olsen's full account of the crash that killed his wife and son and of the out-of-body and near-death experiences he had at the time. It combines and expands his two earlier books and follows his slow return to a life he could welcome.

books.title: Beyond Mile Marker 80
books.author: Jeff Olsen
books.description: The second of Olsen's two original books about his near-death experience, published by Cedar Fort's Plain Sight imprint in 2014. Its material was later folded into his memoir Knowing.

books.title: I Knew Their Hearts
books.author: Jeff Olsen
books.description: Olsen's first book, from 2012, telling the story of the accident and what he says he saw and felt beyond his body. It was later combined with his second book in Knowing.
